itemList.title: C# 12 and .NET 8
itemList.subtitle: Modern Cross-Platform Development Fundamentals
itemList.author: Mark J. Price
itemList.description: A thorough introduction to the .NET environment and how to utilize it to develop backend applications and support full-stack development projects.
itemList.alt: C# 12 and .NET 8, Eighth Edition book cover.

itemList.title: Full Stack Development with Spring Boot 3 and React
itemList.author: Juha Hinkula
itemList.description: Teaches the reader how to develop scalable and secure full-stack web applications through two modern and popular frameworks.
itemList.alt: Full Stack Development with Spring Boot 3 and React, Fourth Edition book cover.

itemList.title: The Data Warehouse Toolkit
itemList.subtitle: The Definitive Guide to Dimensional Modeling
itemList.author: Ralph Kimball, Margy Ross
itemList.description: An investigation into what a data warehouse is, how it can be utilized in impactful ways, and how to systematically develop one. Came in handy during my Fresenius Kabi internship.
itemList.alt: The Data Warehouse Toolkit, Third Edition book cover.

itemList.title: Computer Networking
itemList.subtitle: A Top-Down Approach
itemList.author: James F. Kurose, Keith W. Ross
itemList.description: A thorough description each layer in the TCP/IP network stack.
itemList.alt: Computer Networking, Eighth Edition book cover.

itemList.title: Database Administration
itemList.subtitle: The Complete Guide to DBA Practices and Procedures
itemList.author: Craig S. Mullins
itemList.description: A thorough explanation of the responsibilities and practices of a DBA, as well as the importance of a business to view its data as an asset.
itemList.alt: Database Administration, Second Edition book cover.

itemList.title: Databasesystemer
itemList.author: Bjørn Kristoffersen
itemList.description: Translating to "Database Systems" in English, this book introduces the reader to SQL, databases, and DBMS fundamentals through the lense of MySQL.

itemList.title: SQL Server 2019 Administrator's Guide
itemList.author: Marek Chmel, Vladimir Muzny
itemList.description: This book serves as a check-list or recipe on how to configure and administer SQL Server 2019 in accordance to the duties of a DBA.
itemList.alt: SQL Server 2019 Administrator's Guide, Second Edition book cover.

itemList.title: Datasikkerhet
itemList.subtitle: Ikke bli svindlernes neste offer
itemList.author: Tom Heine Nätt, Christian F. Heide
itemList.description: Translates to "Computer Security" in English. This book explains various methods and attacks applied by hackers and scammers, as well as steps individuals and organizations can take to protect themselves online against these threats.

itemList.title: Python Crash Course
itemList.author: Eric Matthes
itemList.description: Takes the reader from beginner to intermediate pythoneer level by providing hands-on experience with three different programming projects. I especially learned a lot about refactoring, code design, and working with widely used Python libraries and frameworks.
itemList.alt: Python Crash Course, 2nd Edition book cover.

itemList.title: Digital Fundamentals
itemList.author: Thomas L. Floyd
itemList.description: Beginning with the foundational concepts of logic gates, the book builds continues by exploring the workings of combinational logic circuits and memory cells. From there, the analysis progresses to higher levels of abstraction, examining data storage devices and central processing units (CPUs). Finally, the author offers a broad overview of how an entire computer system functions from a hardware perspective.
itemList.alt: Digital Fundamentals, Eleventh Edition book cover.

itemList.title: Electronics Fundamentals
itemList.subtitle: Circuits, Devices and Applications
itemList.author: Thomas L. Floyd, David L. Buchla
itemList.description: This 1000+ pages long book lays the physics and chemistry foundation for the concepts discussed in Digital Fundamentals. This includes investigating fundamental electronic components (e.g. capacitors, transistors, operational amplifiers) and how these can used to create increasingly more complex circuit systems.
itemList.alt: Electronics Fundamentals, Eighth Edition book cover
